cohort: 16 white New Zealand rabbits, 5-months-old and unmated, were used, with a transverse incision made to the uterus to mimic a cesarean section.
finding: Autologous platelet-rich plasma (PRP) application was effective in preventing post-operative intra-abdominal adhesion formation, reducing inflammation and fibrosis, and showing differences in vascular endothelial growth factor-1 in an experimental rabbit uterine horn model.
mod_finding: PRP was effective in preventing post-operative adhesion formation at a transverse uterine incision line designed to mimic a cesarean section.
